briefs.headline: Wednesday Signal Brief
briefs.lead: Salesforce is turning the agentic-enterprise pitch into a broader commerce platform story, while Shopify is making the AI channel visible inside the admin. The operator takeaway: AI commerce is no longer just a front-end discovery problem. It is becoming a coordinated layer across catalog data, customer context, workflows, ads and checkout.

items.title: Salesforce makes AIforce the new enterprise interface
items.summary: At Dreamforce, Salesforce positioned AIforce as an interface layer connecting enterprise data, applications and agents. For commerce teams, the shift is toward AI systems that can surface context and take action across the stack instead of forcing users to navigate separate tools.

items.title: Salesforce adds Koa and Claudeforce to its agentic stack
items.summary: Salesforce announced Koa, a reasoning model for sales, marketing and support, plus Claudeforce integrations that let Claude work with Salesforce data and tasks. The practical implication is a more open, model-agnostic layer for commerce workflows.

items.title: Shopify moves Sidekick deeper into the admin
items.summary: Shopify's September 15 admin redesign moves Sidekick to the bottom of every page and gives the platform a more AI-native operating surface. The bigger signal is that AI assistance is becoming part of daily merchant operations, not a separate tool.

items.title: Salesforce connects Agentforce to engineering-grade product data
items.summary: Siemens is pairing Teamcenter with Agentforce so sales and service agents can use engineering-grade answers in customer workflows. For complex-commerce brands, the lesson is that agent quality depends on connecting product and service context—not just adding a chat layer.

briefs.headline: Tuesday Signal Brief
briefs.lead: AI commerce is moving another step toward infrastructure. Cloudflare is changing how AI agents reach websites, Salesforce is putting agents into real operational workflows at Dreamforce, and Shopify is continuing to expand the API layer behind agentic commerce.

items.title: Cloudflare changes the default rules for AI agents
items.summary: New Cloudflare domains and qualifying sites with ads default to allowing search crawlers while blocking AI training and agent traffic. Merchants need to make an explicit decision about how AI agents should access their storefront content.

items.title: Air India expands Agentforce into end-to-end service workflows
items.summary: Air India is expanding Agentforce beyond refund processing into broader service workflows. Salesforce says refund turnaround fell from about 14 days to 4 hours and passenger-name updates from 3 days to 30 minutes.

items.title: Shopify opens its 2026-10 API release candidate
items.summary: Shopify's 2026-10 release candidate adds changes across orders, metafields, customer accounts, tax, analytics and Storefront APIs, extending the platform surface available to agentic storefronts and integrations.

briefs.headline: Monday Signal Brief
briefs.lead: The AI commerce stack is getting more operational.

briefs.headline: Friday Signal Brief
briefs.lead: AI commerce is starting to look like an advertising channel, not just a shopping interface.

briefs.headline: Thursday Signal Brief
briefs.lead: Agentic commerce is moving from discovery into the trust layer.
